rubric.item: SPEC-11 correctness (Q-2 locked edits routine, no assertions removed, no expected values changed)
SPEC-12 correctness (gate lint/typecheck/test pass; src/engine, src/bots, src/advice unchanged)

findings.issue: A-2 says a players-count change discards per-seat edits (setEdits({}) in the players onChange), but no test exercises it. SPEC-10 only covers the preset change. Removing setEdits({}) here would leave every test passing; today a stale edit would either throw (seat no longer a bot, e.g. 6->2 players) or silently carry over to a different bot name.
findings.evidence: e2e/seat-style.spec.ts tests only preset(page,'Mixed').check() after an edit; vitest renderToString cannot fire onChange; GameConfigScreen.tsx coverage 70% with the handlers uncovered.
findings.fix: In e2e/seat-style.spec.ts (SPEC-10 test or a new short one) select Rock for Cal, change #config-players to 4 then back to 6, and assert rowTexts equals the unedited Mixed rows.

findings.issue: rowTexts() is read once right after selectOption with a plain expect(...).toEqual, so the assertion does not retry if React has not re-rendered yet. It passes today (both browsers), but it is the one non-auto-waiting check in the flow.
findings.fix: Use await expect.poll(() => rowTexts(page)).toEqual([...]), or first await expect(styleSelect(...)).toHaveValue(...) as the SPEC-09 test does.

findings.issue: useWorkerTimers/restorePausedTimers/axeWithPausedClock are copied verbatim from lineup-choice/action-bar/next-hand specs instead of living in e2e/support. This follows the existing project pattern (spec says reuse the lineup-choice patterns), so not a regression.
findings.evidence: Same functions in e2e/action-bar.spec.ts:34,64 and e2e/next-hand.spec.ts:72,102.
findings.fix: Optional follow-up: move axeWithPausedClock into e2e/support/axe.ts and import it.

findings.issue: SPEC-04 says the loop stops as soon as a differing decision is seen; playSeat finishes the current hand first. Harmless (more checks, still capped at 200 hands).
findings.evidence: if (differs) return true; after the while loop.
findings.fix: None needed; or adjust the docstring/spec wording.

summary: Implementation matches the spec. configWithSeatStyle validates style and bot seat, maps seats to LineUpSeat and reuses lineUpSessionConfig for the Custom/preset name (no re-implemented comparison). GameConfigScreen folds edits over configForLineUp so rows and Start game share one seated config; preset and players changes clear edits; select values are validated with isBotStyle against BOT_STYLES; aria-label 'Style for <name>', no id, visible 'Style' label, no Random. A-1 row interpretation (row 3 = Cal at table seat 2) is used consistently in model and browser tests. SPEC-04/06 are meaningful: they go through handleAdviceRequest with botTurn's style/seed, assert turn.style, assert equality with the style's own decide function, and require at least one decision differing from decideTag (returns false and fails if the seat never deviates or never acts), so a TAG-only worker or a lost edit would fail. Q-2 locked edits (home, players, stake, lineup unit; game-type, stake, lineup e2e) only add the selected-option cell or scope select/combobox counts to the Session panel; no expect removed, no expected values changed. Verified: 21 new/amended vitest tests pass; seat-style + amended e2e specs pass in Chromium and WebKit (20/20); git diff of src/engine, src/bots, src/advice is empty; e2e waits are bounded (no hands played) and axe runs after the edit. Only MINOR/NIT findings.
